title: Anxiety and the Peace of Christ
subtitle: A guided route through the worry that will not turn off — four essays, a study, and a book.
forWhom: For the reader who lies awake running the same loop, and who knows the difference between the fear a doctor should hear and the fear only the Father can quiet.

title: Faith and the Flag
subtitle: When the cross gets conscripted — four essays, a study, and a book.
forWhom: For the reader in a church that has started to sound like a campaign, and for the one who suspects their own side is not innocent either.

title: Making Disciples at the Table
subtitle: Discipleship without a program — four essays, a study, and a book.
forWhom: For the ordinary Christian with no title and no training who suspects that following Jesus was always meant to be handed on, not just attended.

title: When Faith Has Questions
subtitle: For the reader taking the faith apart — four essays, a study, and a book.
forWhom: For the Christian with real questions and the skeptic who left over them — anyone who would rather have an honest doubt than a dishonest certainty.

title: Manhood, the Father Wound, and Raising Sons
subtitle: Two essays, a study, and a book — from a man raised without a father, raising five sons.
forWhom: For the man carrying a wound he never named, and for anyone raising a boy toward a manhood the culture keeps counterfeiting.

title: Marriage, Past the Tips
subtitle: For a marriage that needs more than technique — four essays, a study, and a book.
forWhom: For two people who are not in crisis and not fine either, and who suspect the slow drift is more dangerous than the loud fight.

title: Money and the Heart
subtitle: What the heart does with treasure — four essays, a study, and a book.
forWhom: For the worried and the comfortable alike — the reader who suspects their bank statement is a truer confession than their doctrine.

title: Raising Kids Who Keep the Faith
subtitle: Forming a child's heart, not just their behavior — four essays, a study, and a book.
forWhom: For the parent less worried about raising a well-behaved child than a child whose faith survives contact with the world.

title: Learning to Pray Again
subtitle: How do you actually pray? Four essays, a study, and a book for the reader whose prayers have gone quiet.
forWhom: For the one who believes prayer matters and cannot remember the last time it felt like anything.

title: Faith and the Cause
subtitle: When the gospel gets recruited to a cause — five essays, a study, and a book.
forWhom: For the reader in a church that has started to sound like a movement, and for the one honest enough to ask whether their own side has a captivity too.

title: Rest, Sabbath, and the Cure for Hurry
subtitle: You do not have a time problem. Three essays, a study, and a book on the rhythm the church forgot.
forWhom: For the tired — and for the one who cannot tell the difference between tired and done.

title: When the Weight Doesn't Lift
subtitle: For grief that has outlasted everyone's patience — four essays, a study, and a book.
forWhom: For the reader carrying a loss the world expected them to be over by now, and for anyone sitting beside them with nothing to say.

title: Work and the Weight of Monday
subtitle: Is your job just a paycheck? Three essays, a study, and a book on the work God actually sees.
forWhom: For the reader whose Monday feels like a different world than their Sunday — and suspects it should not.
